summary: Lunai Bioworks filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing that it formally asked Nasdaq to immediately suspend trading in its common stock (LNAI) while Nasdaq, FINRA and other authorities review trading records tied to its pending Delaware litigation, Lunai Bioworks, Inc. v. Seven Points Capital LLC et al., Case No. 1:26-cv-00549-CFC. The records, from court-ordered discovery and described in a Second Amended Complaint filed August 26, 2026, allegedly show substantial short selling, locate deficiencies and concentrated fails-to-deliver. No halt decision has been received; Nasdaq retains discretion. Watch for regulatory response and litigation developments.
